Step 3. The unitary operator \(P_{01320013}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle P_{01320013} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via Laplace interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01320011 \cdot C_01320012 \cdot C_01320013\).
